name: A & E Kitchen Service LLC
old_description: A & E Kitchen Service LLC, founded in 2000 provides service for our customers and manufacturers of commercial kitchen equipment.  Servicing commercial cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing equipment and HVAC needs for restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and institutions throughout southwest Missouri.
about:
A & E Kitchen Service LLC was founded in 2000 in Springfield, Missouri. The company provides service and support for commercial kitchen equipment manufacturers and end users across southwest Missouri, including the Springfield, Branson, and Joplin areas.

The firm operates a field service force of five technicians, a dispatcher, and a parts manager. Its technicians, who average 15 years of experience and hold certifications in electric, gas, steam, and refrigeration systems, perform on-site repair, installation, start-up, preventive maintenance, and factory-authorized warranty work on cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing, and HVAC equipment. The shop also handles minor construction, electrical, plumbing, and welding tasks.

Customers range from independent restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and other institutions to equipment manufacturers such as Hobart, Hoshizaki, Vulcan, and more than 150 other brands for which A & E provides factory-authorized warranty service.

The company emphasizes direct technician contact—no call center—and offers 24-hour weekend and emergency response. Its combination of geographic coverage and technical breadth allows clients to consolidate their food-service equipment support under one provider.
